guideline: Participants compare audio samples and select which better conveys the emotion based on evaluation metrics such as ESA, EEA, EDT, EIT, ESC, EEC, EST.
Participants were presented binary choice questions for each metric and instructed that responses would be used to evaluate the new emotional TTS framework.
The study involved 23 university student volunteers, was approved by IRB, and responses were anonymized.
